{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any non-numeric values that became NaN
print("Number of rows with invalid revenue (became NaN after conversion):", sales['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Display the first few rows after conversion
type(sales['revenue'].iloc[0])"}
